decision: Is the converged L1c calibration residual explained by one global probability scale, nonlinear current-observation tie-breaking, or temporal ambiguity in the collector target?

diagnosis.global_scale_fit: minimize unregularized NLL over one positive scalar using training episodes only

hypothesis: If the only failed L1c gate is caused by a global probability-scale residual, one train-only positive logit scale will improve training NLL and bring training ECE below the already frozen 0.0287317628 limit without changing any argmax; otherwise exact feature-only reconstruction of the reactive collector will select one small current-observation nonlinear ablation rather than history.
non_goals: no mutation of the corpus or frozen L1c artifact
no deployable fit, promotion decision, HIT-reduction claim, or NMNB claim
no scaled-validation evaluation before the next ablation is selected and preregistered
no MLP, temperature export, history, auxiliary head, or IQL in this diagnosis

selection_rule.invariant_failure: stop and repair feature-only reactive reconstruction before any ablation
selection_rule.nonlinear_condition: the global-scale condition fails while current features reconstruct the reactive collector exactly
selection_rule.scale_condition: the train-only optimum improves train NLL and train ECE is at most the frozen 0.0287317628 limit
